name: desktop-server
description: BizFlow Desktop Server - Electron wrapper untuk deployment on-premise
author: Bagus Uswanto

scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/*.html src/renderer/*.css src/renderer/*.js dist/renderer/ && mkdir -p dist/resources && cp src/resources/*.svg dist/resources/
scripts.dev: tsc && mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/*.html src/renderer/*.css src/renderer/*.js dist/renderer/ && mkdir -p dist/resources && cp src/resources/*.svg dist/resources/ && electron .
